featuredSeries.title: "Leading Edge" Docuseries
featuredSeries.creator: Kyle Lewis & Icepack Media
featuredSeries.description: "Leading Edge" is an inside-look docuseries spearheaded by Kyle Lewis, following the student-athletes, coaches, and behind-the-scenes preparation of the NC State Icepack throughout the season.

episodes.title: Governor's Cup
episodes.description: For the season finale, the Icepack face off against archrival UNC for the Governor's Cup at Lenovo Center on the biggest stage of the year. Who will take home the trophy?

episodes.title: Character
episodes.description: The Icepack travel to Charlotte for a special outdoor game at Truist Field against South Carolina, followed by a matchup against the West Point Army Knights at Fort Liberty.

episodes.title: Turbulence
episodes.description: The Icepack host Penn State at Invisalign Arena, looking to redeem themselves following a grueling three-game weekend during the Stephen Russell Memorial Tournament.

episodes.title: Triple Play
episodes.description: The Icepack host the Stephen Russell Memorial Tournament, playing 3 games in 3 days against New Hampshire, Bowling Green, and Louisville as new players step up.

episodes.title: Rivalry
episodes.description: The Icepack face archrival University of North Carolina for the first time of the season in front of a sold-out crowd at Invisalign Arena.

episodes.title: The Legacy Continues
episodes.description: NC State takes on Rider University, followed by an exhibition matchup taking down Division I powerhouse Alabama to prove the Pack can compete at any level.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.description: The Icepack close out their New Jersey road trip against Rowan and return home to face undefeated South Carolina, kicking off a 6-week home run at Invisalign Arena.

episodes.title: Road Runners
episodes.description: Follows the Icepack as they travel to Virginia to face off against rival Virginia Tech, before immediately heading to New Jersey for back-to-back games against Rowan.

episodes.title: Breaking the Ice
episodes.description: The docuseries premiere introducing the NC State Icepack roster, coaching staff, and behind-the-scenes culture as the 2024–2025 season gets underway.
